dog.description_text: Sylvia is an adorable 10 month-old female. She and her sister, Oprah, were the only surviving kittens from their litter and are now being fostered together. They have feline Leukemia but despite their rough start to life, they’re both thriving now! Sylvia, the leader of the duo, is an adventurous love bug who will curl up on your lap or by your side for a nap. Oprah (the tabby) is a complete purr machine, revving up her engine after just 1-2 pets! Both girls are VERY playful and food motivated. They are adoptable as a bonded pair.
dog.name: Sylvia
